major_concerns: Verifier coverage may not capture all operational invariants, confounding attribution of residual failures to verifier limits vs generator errors.
Emulator fidelity might overestimate real-world safety (vendor-specific behaviors, timing, rollback semantics).
Single-model evaluation limits generality; hosted-model non-determinism may inflate variance.
Retry and error-recovery policy needs clearer bounds to avoid post-hoc reruns.
required_design_repairs: Add explicit verifier-coverage tests (oracle/unit tasks) and report verifier limitations per property class.
Document emulator fidelity limits and include at least one vendor-like behavioral test (e.g., vendor CLI semantics) or clearly state scope.
Prespecify and log retry policy, exact seeds, and API-versioning; record nondeterminism and quantify its contribution to variance.
Consider a small multi-model robustness check (e.g., one additional model or smaller local model) or justify single-model choice in threats to validity.

major_concerns: High ethical risk from publishing actionable attack templates that could be weaponized.
Responsible-disclosure and redaction procedures are underspecified.
Simulator limits may under- or over-estimate adversary effectiveness; external-impact mitigation is required.
required_design_repairs: Embed a documented responsible-disclosure policy and explicit redaction rules for any released attack artifacts; include a non-public forensic log for reviewers if required by the track.
Add an ethics review statement (IRB-equivalent or institutional sign-off) and a rationale for what attack detail will be redacted in public artifacts.
Prespecify attacker-strength levels and limit public release to high-level patterns; include defended/benign baselines and fully reproducible sanitized artifacts.
Quantify simulator-to-production transfer risk and add conservative caveats in threat-to-validity section.

major_concerns: Some constrained-decoding methods require model-side features not available via hosted APIs; client-side approximations change comparability.
Parallel/multi-path generation may exceed budget or change conclusions depending on N; trade-off parameters need prespecification.
Latency measurement in emulated environment may not generalize to deployed serving environments.
required_design_repairs: Prespecify feasible constrained-decoding implementations usable with hosted APIs and document approximations (e.g., post-hoc filtering, grammar-guided sampling).
Preregister N and max aggregate-model-call budgets for multi-path experiments and perform sensitivity analysis across N values.
Report latency normalized to wall-clock and to model-invocation counts; discuss generalization to production serving in threats to validity.

major_concerns: Risk of overfitting benchmark tasks to the pipelines under test; small benchmark size may limit generalizability.
Adversarial task release raises ethical disclosure concerns similar to Candidate 2.
Rollback semantics in the emulator may diverge from vendor implementations, affecting external validity.
required_design_repairs: Include a hold-out validation set or community challenge plan to mitigate overfitting and report benchmark creation/selection procedures transparently.
Adopt and document responsible-disclosure/redaction rules for adversarial tasks; release sanitized artifacts and provide secure forensic logs for reviewers if needed.
Clarify emulator rollback semantics, map them to representative vendor behaviors, and list which production behaviors are out of scope.
